title: Toolchain check before the model call
goal: The coding runner reports a missing container engine as an error naming the fix, before any model call
acceptance: No container engine: an error result with the fix on stderr, complete false, and no model request
privacy: No data: runner and grader control flow only.
validation: Regression test committed failing first; npm test; CI
escalation: A change to the executor contract is an owner decision
